# Stellus Capital Management, LLC Provides Unitranche Financing In Support Of Bernhard Capital Partners’ Investment In Revenew International


Sep 22, 2026


######


###### SHARE


**Houston, TX – September 22, 2026** – Stellus Capital Management, LLC (“Stellus”) announced today that its affiliates provided senior debt financing and an equity co-investment in support of Bernhard Capital Partners’ (“Bernhard”) acquisition of Revenew International (“Revenew” or the “Company”), a leading provider of contract compliance, profit recovery and performance consulting services across the utility, energy, manufacturing, mining, pharmaceutical and chemical industries.


Headquartered in Houston, Revenew helps organizations uncover and recover value through contract compliance, supplier payment reviews, performance improvement and sales and use tax recovery. The Company’s technology-enabled delivery model and proprietary data platform support long-term customer relationships across the asset-intensive industries it supports.


Jonathan Parnell, Managing Director at Bernhard, said, “We appreciate Stellus’ thoughtfulness in providing a flexible financing structure that allows for Revenew’s continued growth and execution of our investment thesis. We look forward to building a strong relationship with Stellus going forward.”


Gavin Roseman, Partner at Stellus, added, “We are excited about the opportunity to partner with Bernhard on this transaction. Bernhard’s domain expertise coupled with the Company’s strong market positioning and favorable industry tailwinds position the Company well for continued growth”.
